operations.text: 0.3.19 teaches the plan gate the second form of a decision bullet. Besides - **D-NN** <text>, the form /pnp:plan writes, the gate now reads - **D-NN <title>** - the title inside the bold, closed on the same line - the form of plans written under an earlier version. Two consequences. A plan whose DECISIONS.md writes the title form now has its decisions read, so the check that every decision is cited may newly refuse such an ACTIVE plan when one of its plan:-tagged decisions is cited by no ticket and no index line; cite it, or tag it for the plan that implements it, before the next stamp. And a <X>/D-NN cross-reference into such a plan, active or archived, now resolves and is hashed into the stamp instead of being refused as unresolved. A bullet of the first form is parsed and hashed exactly as before, so every existing stamp over a first-form plan stays valid. New plans keep writing - **D-NN** <text>. This update re-renders no managed file and changes no config key: the plan gate and the skills are read from the plugin root and arrive with the version.
